usedFor: AgentMail holds the inboxes, and Conversion Chats receives work from “New Email Bounced” through “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Bounced” in AgentMail, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A bounce carries the bounce type and recipients, so the template runs only for mail that failed.

watchOut: Limit “New Email Received” to selected inboxes or pods, or every inbound email starts “Send Template Message”.
